sources.name: Database of Political Institutions 2023
sources.detail: Inter-American Development Bank, CC-BY 4.0. Left-right orientation of the chief executive's party, 1975-2023.

sources.name: V-Party v2
sources.detail: V-Dem Institute, 2022. Expert-coded party positions, used to fill country-years DPI leaves blank. Ends around 2019.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.detail: Property P1387, political alignment, joined to dated head-of-government terms. Extends the series past 2023.

sources.name: Regimes of the World
sources.detail: V-Dem via Our World in Data, 1789-2025. Closed and electoral autocracies, electoral and liberal democracies.

sources.name: Population
sources.detail: Our World in Data and the UN World Population Prospects. Historical to 2023, medium-variant projection after.

sources.name: Hand-coded rows
sources.detail: Countries no source resolves, coded here with a written basis and a verification date for each.

meta.note: no_reading means left-right genuinely does not apply - an absolute monarchy, a military government, a big-tent personality vehicle. unresolved means we lack data. They are different claims and are never merged. Each year reports which source resolved it.

dpi.label: DPI
dpi.note: Database of Political Institutions. Codes the chief executive's party as left, right or centre. Covers 1975 to 2023.

vparty.label: V-Party
vparty.note: V-Party, an expert survey of party positions from the V-Dem Institute. Fills country-years DPI leaves blank. Ends around 2019.

carry_forward.label: Carry-forward
carry_forward.note: V-Party's rating of a party, reapplied to later years where DPI still records that same party in power.

hand.label: Hand-coded
hand.note: Coded here, with a written basis and a verification date for every row.

wikidata.label: Wikidata
wikidata.note: Wikidata's political alignment property, joined to dated head-of-government terms. This is what extends the series past 2023.

no_reading.label: Not applicable
no_reading.note: No left-right reading applies: an absolute monarchy, a military government, or a big-tent personality vehicle.

unresolved.label: No data
unresolved.note: No source places this country-year on the left-right axis.

palette.note: colour is the light-theme value. colour_dark, where present, replaces it under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

world.label: All countries
world.note: Everything the source data covers. Default view.

g20.label: G20
g20.note: Excludes the EU and African Union bloc seats, which have no single government.

brics.label: BRICS+
brics.note: Founding five plus the 2024 expansion, plus Indonesia (Jan 2025). Saudi Arabia was invited but has not formally acceded — excluded.

asean.label: ASEAN
asean.note: Timor-Leste acceded as the 11th member in October 2025.

africa.label: Africa
africa.note: Resolved from OWID continent mapping at build time.

asia.label: Asia
asia.note: Resolved from OWID continent mapping at build time.

europe.label: Europe
europe.note: Resolved from OWID continent mapping at build time.

north_america.label: North America
north_america.note: Resolved from OWID continent mapping at build time.

south_america.label: South America
south_america.note: Resolved from OWID continent mapping at build time.

oceania.label: Oceania
oceania.note: Resolved from OWID continent mapping at build time.

african_union.label: African Union
african_union.note: Excludes Western Sahara, which has no OWID population series in this build.

anglosphere.label: Anglosphere
anglosphere.note: Six English-speaking democracies with closely related party systems.
